delivery.outcome: Decompose god function compile_inert_plan in src/koru/poa/plan_compile.py (PLF-034): extract planning-input/policy-boundary validation (_validate_planning_inputs returning a _ValidatedInputs NamedTuple), snapshot validity-window enforcement (_require_validity_window), plan-request hashing (_request_hash), per-step compilation (_compile_planned_steps over _planned_step, _compensation_process_uri and _binding_evidence, returning a _PlannedCompilation NamedTuple), plan assembly (_build_plan returning a _CompiledPlan NamedTuple) and result assembly (_planning_result), dropping compile_inert_plan from CC=10 / fan-out=18 / mutations=23 to CC=1 / fan-out=8 / mutations=5 (god-function thresholds: fan-out > 10, mutations > 6, CC > 12) while producing a value-identical planning result: same validation order and error messages, same key sets (compensation_process_uri present only when the step declares a compensation capability), same idempotency-key and plan_id derivation, and same hash-pinned plan/result documents; the module's public API (compile_inert_plan, verify_planning_result) is unchanged.
nonGoals: Refactoring the separately ticketed verify_planning_result and _select_bindings smells in the same module
Changing the poa.plan/v1 or koru.poa/planning-result/v1 document shapes or the module's public API
Altering binding selection, dependency-graph validation or any validation semantics

architecture.decision: Single-level helper extraction with NamedTuple results: compile_inert_plan keeps only validate/window/request/graph/select/compile/build/result orchestration. The code2llm mutation heuristic counts every assignment and mutation-method call inside a function body, so the removed assignments (validated documents, expected policy input, parsed datetimes, request/plan/result dicts, loop accumulators) must move out of the function rather than merely be reorganized; helpers each stay at or below fan-out 9 / mutations 4 / CC 7 (measured). The conditional compensation_process_uri key is derived in its own helper and only written into the planned step when the step declares a compensation capability, preserving the closed plan document shape; document key order is irrelevant to the RFC8785 canonical hashes but preserved regardless.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single inline compile_inert_plan body.

Existing POA suites pass unchanged; behavior is preserved by pure extraction (same public API, same documents).
